scripts.format: node scripts/rust-check.mjs format && prettier --write tests scripts rust/src/runtime *.json *.jsonc migrations/*.sql --ignore-unknown
scripts.format:check: node scripts/rust-check.mjs format:check && prettier --check tests scripts rust/src/runtime *.json *.jsonc --ignore-unknown
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply auth-local --local --config wrangler.fixture.jsonc
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute auth-local --local --config wrangler.fixture.jsonc --file local-seed.sql
scripts.test: node scripts/rust-check.mjs test && npm run build:rust && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
